cores.name: Shared Knowledge / Company Memory
cores.proof_requirement: A current external database check or repeatable sync/query run proving the canonical memory substrate exists. Repository files or a PR alone are CONFIG_ONLY.

cores.name: Autonomous Job Execution
cores.proof_requirement: Recent successful run from every critical worker lane. A current failure outranks an older success. Unused experimental/director workflows do not count as critical runtime dependencies.

cores.name: Execution Logs / Audit / CEO Truth
cores.proof_requirement: Reality Control Plane and BOSS value evidence both have recent successful runs. Static registry labels cannot promote runtime status.

cores.name: Revenue-Producing Agent
cores.proof_requirement: Runtime success proves only operation. REVENUE_CONNECTED additionally requires a trusted verified commercial event; cash requires stage=payment, positive amount_yen, and evidence_ref.
